newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed up 0.06 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 496.88 points from 496.60 on Friday.
Total volume was 429,422 dinars against 4.38 million dinars over the previous session.

Banque de Tunisie, which is to hold its annual general meeting on Tuesday, fell 0.8 dinar to 78.3 dinars. Societe Tunisienne de Banque slid 0.54 dinar to 17.52. Banque de l'Habitat was down 0.49 dinar to 18.1 dinars.
Detergent firm SPCD eased 0.16 dinar to 36.34 dinars.
Tunisian company Le Moteur won 1.74 dinar to 33 dinars.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT was up 0.5 dinar to 90. Retail stores Monoprix rose 0.2 dinar to 37.5 dinars. ($1=1.08 dinar)
